n_inthis.text: In this video, I'll show you how to link your Jet Up account to TAG Markets, step by step, on your phone.

n_ov1.text: You'll log in to Jet Up, scroll down to the Copy X banner, and tap Register Copy X.

n_ov2.text: Then you'll enter your Jet Up password, tick the boxes, and wait for User Active.

n_ov3.text: Finally, you'll log in to TAG Markets, confirm your email, and see your dashboard.

s_same.text: Use the same email and password you created in part one.

s_scroll.text: On your profile, scroll down to the Copy X banner.

s_pw.text: It asks for your password. Enter the same password you created on Jet Up.

s_tick.text: Read and tick the three boxes, then tap Sync Account.

s_synced.text: Sync successful! TAG Markets will email you to validate your password.

s_close.text: Tick the box to say you understand, and tap Close.

s_login.text: Now the button says Login to Copy X. Tap it to open TAG Markets.

s_tip.text: Username or password incorrect? Check your password. It must be exactly the one you created on Jet Up.

s_human.text: TAG Markets checks that you're human. Just wait a moment.

s_dash.text: You're on your TAG Markets dashboard. It asks you to complete your K Y C. We'll do that in part three.

s_mail.text: Now check your email. The TAG Markets email can take a while. Mine arrived after my first log in.

s_confirm.text: Open the email from TAG Markets, and tap Confirm email address.

s_valid.text: Verification successful! Your email is validated.

s_click.text: If the page doesn't move on, tap click here, and log in again.

s_done.text: And you're back on your dashboard, with your email confirmed. Well done!

r1.text: You logged in to Jet Up, scrolled down to the Copy X banner, and tapped Register Copy X.

r2.text: You entered your Jet Up password, ticked the boxes, and saw User Active.

r3.text: Then you logged in to TAG Markets, confirmed your email, and reached your dashboard.

x1.text: In the next video, part three, I'll show you how to verify your identity on TAG Markets.

x2.text: You'll tap upload documents, scan your I D card, and take a quick selfie.
